name: std-role-gate
description: std-role-gate — explicit role gate around ONE piece of UI. Renders its `content` trait only when `roles` is empty or lists the viewer's role; any other viewer gets nothing rendered. Wrap a single button, FAB or panel in it, bind `viewerRole` at the call site (e.g. `viewerRole: @user.role`), and list the roles that may see it.

schema.description: std-role-gate — explicit role gate around ONE piece of UI. Renders its `content` trait only when `roles` is empty or lists the viewer's role; any other viewer gets nothing rendered. Wrap a single button, FAB or panel in it, bind `viewerRole` at the call site (e.g. `viewerRole: @user.role`), and list the roles that may see it.
schema.name: std-role-gate

content.description: The trait rendered when the viewer's role is allowed, e.g. a button or panel trait ref.
content.label: Gated content
content.synonyms: wrapped content, guarded element, protected button

roles.description: Roles (matched against viewerRole) that see the content. Empty = everyone; any other viewer sees nothing.
roles.label: Visible to roles
roles.synonyms: allowed roles, only for, who can see, permitted roles

viewerRole.description: The signed-in viewer's role that `roles` is checked against. Bind it explicitly at the call site (e.g. `viewerRole: @user.role`); left empty, only an ungated (empty `roles`) gate renders.
viewerRole.label: Viewer's role
